text: The unit shall detect a 1 square meter radar cross-section target at a minimum range of 45 kilometers under clear-weather conditions.
The unit shall achieve a range resolution of 15 meters or better.
The unit shall operate continuously for 500 hours between scheduled maintenance actions.
The unit shall operate within an ambient temperature range of -45°C to 71°C without degradation in performance (reference: MIL-STD-810H, Method 501.7 and 502.7).
The unit shall withstand random vibration testing for a minimum duration of 2 hours per axis, per MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8, Category 4 (equipment category: ground, mobile).
The unit shall function at altitudes up to 6000 meters above mean sea level per MIL-STD-810H Method 500.6.
The unit shall meet IP65 ingress protection rating for dust and water resistance.
The unit shall operate from a nominal 28 VDC supply and shall tolerate transients up to 60 V without damage, per MIL-STD-461G, CS116.
The unit shall not exceed 850 W average power consumption in Mode 1 (search) and 1200 W in Mode 2 (track).
The unit shall limit conducted emissions per MIL-STD-461G, CE102, across the 10 kHz to 10 MHz band.
The unit shall provide an emergency stop control that removes all RF transmission within 200 milliseconds of activation, per MIL-STD-882E hazard mitigation guidance.
The unit shall not present an electric shock hazard exceeding the limits of MIL-STD-882E, Table III, Severity Category II.
The unit shall include interlocks that prevent high-voltage access panels from being opened while the transmitter is energized.
The unit shall provide a MIL-STD-1553B data bus interface for command and telemetry.
The unit shall provide a 10/100BASE-T Ethernet maintenance port, connector type P/N 7741-0032.
The unit shall not exceed a total mass of 35.5 kg including mounting hardware.
The unit shall provide a visual BITE (built-in test equipment) status indicator visible from 3 meters.
The unit shall achieve a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of no less than 2,000 hours.
The unit shall achieve a Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) of no more than 30 minutes for line-replaceable unit swaps.
All requirements in Section 3 shall be verified by test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration as recorded in the associated test report.
